profile.headline: Senior Full Stack AI/ML Engineer | Agentic AI Systems & Production ML Platforms | Python, React, AWS | West Point CS Grad | Army Veteran
profile.summary:
I build production AI systems that solve real problems in high-stakes domains. Over the past 6+ years, I've architected agentic AI platforms for healthcare, designed ML systems that reduced false positives by 30% in cybersecurity, and modernized legacy fintech applications into cloud-native microservices.


At SimWerx, I designed and built a hierarchical agentic systems using the OpenAI Agents SDK and Model Context Protocol, turning paramedic audio narratives into compliant medical reports. Streamlining their process from days to minutes. Utilizing LLMs in our data pipeline for unstructured data extraction, entity extraction, insight generation, and report generation. 

At Securin, I led the ML platform powering exploit prediction for ~50 enterprise customers, including a hybrid ensemble scoring system that became the primary risk metric across all customer environments. I managed training and inference pipelines processing 500-1,000 vulnerabilities per batch cycle, four times daily.

Before tech, I served as a U.S. Army Signal Officer, leading 90 telecommunications personnel and sustaining networks for 800+ users at 99% uptime. I'm a West Point Computer Science graduate, and that foundation of mission-focused execution shapes how I build and ship software today.

Core technologies: Python, Java, TypeScript, React, FastAPI, Spring Boot, AWS, Docker, MongoDB, Redis, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, scikit-learn, RAG, Vector Search


I'm open to senior AI/ML engineering, full stack, and technical leadership roles. Let's connect.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Generative AI
positions.description:
Owned end-to-end design and implementation of agentic AI systems, frontend applications, and backend services across two healthcare products: an ePCR report generation platform for paramedics and a clinical decision support system.

- Engineered a hierarchical agentic system using the OpenAI Agents SDK to orchestrate a multi-stage medical narrative pipeline, with specialized sub-agents utilizing the Model Context Protocol for text preprocessing, vector-based protocol retrieval, data extraction, and report synthesis.

- Built an automated evaluation pipeline using Pydantic Evals that drove a 30% increase in entity precision and reduced hallucination rates by 20%, replacing manual review processes.

- Developed a full stack application (React, FastAPI, Celery, MongoDB) to operationalize multi-stage medical narrative processing with real-time user interactions and asynchronous job management.

- Built an LLM-powered clinical decision support system serving AI-generated guidance during critical patient care scenarios, field-tested by approximately 300 soldiers.
positions.insights: Skills: Generative AI · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Model Context Protocol (MCP) · Agentic AI Development · React.js · Flutter · FastAPI · Celery · MongoDB · Data Pipelines · Event-driven Architecture

positions.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
Led ML engineering team for Securin's vulnerability intelligence product following the acquisition of CYR3CON, owning model training pipelines, inference infrastructure, scoring architecture, and production reliability serving approximately 50 enterprise customers.

- Architected an end-to-end ML platform on AWS automating data processing and model experimentation, boosting deployment efficiency by 30% and decreasing model inference time by 40% with a novel feature store.

- Designed a hybrid ensemble scoring system combining 34 industry-specific Random Forest models with rule-based heuristics, reducing false positives by 30% and becoming the primary risk metric across all customer environments.

- Developed and deployed production ML systems using a microservices architecture supporting both scalable batch and on-demand inference for critical cybersecurity models.

- Led a cross-functional team in advancing vulnerability management models, authoring user stories and translating business KPIs into technical features using threat intelligence insights.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MLOps · Communication · Computer Science · Cloud Computing · Analytical Skills · Docker · Scikit-Learn · Machine Learning · MongoDB · Problem Solving · Interpersonal Skills · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
Served as Senior Machine Learning Engineer with full ownership of an exploit prediction platform that scored vulnerability risk for enterprise security teams, managing three backend engineers and all ML architecture decisions.

- Built and maintained 34 supervised ML models (Random Forest classifiers) predicting vulnerability exploitation likelihood across industry-specific attack surfaces including finance, healthcare, and government.

- Designed a feature store architecture using Redis and MongoDB, ensuring offline/online feature parity and significantly improving training and inference runtime performance.

- Managed ETL data pipelines supporting near real-time ingestion and model prediction, processing 500–1,000 vulnerabilities per batch cycle across 34 industry-specific models.

- Performed feature engineering and data analysis across CVE metadata, CVSS vectors, exploit databases, and social media threat signals, improving model precision by 15% across industry-specific prediction models.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MLOps · Communication · Computer Science · Analytical Skills · Machine Learning · MongoDB · Problem Solving · Interpersonal Skills · Python (Programming Language) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Docker

positions.title: Cloud Native Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded as a consulting engineer on a Fortune 500 fintech modernization project, building cloud-native microservices and customer-facing React applications as part of a dedicated product squad using Extreme Programming practices.

- Modernized 7 legacy applications to cloud-based, event-driven microservices using Java Spring Boot, React, and RabbitMQ, improving system responsiveness and scalability.

- Built 6 customer-facing pages with dynamic routing in React and TypeScript, including multi-step workflows with client-side validation and Redux state management.

- Implemented multi-stage CI/CD pipelines via Jenkins with unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, and introduced API contract testing to improve integration reliability.

- Practiced Extreme Programming including pair programming, TDD, and continuous refactoring within an Agile product squad.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Computer Science · Analytical Skills · React.js · Java · Problem Solving · Interpersonal Skills · Event-driven Architecture · Redux.js · RabbitMQ · Java · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Knowledge Management Officer
positions.description:
• Created the Knowledge Management Policy to enhance the flow of information throughout the organization of 15,000 personnel.
• Met with Department Heads and key leaders to identify the challenges they faced and developed systems to overcome them.
• Developed and deployed 12 sub-sites on a SharePoint 2013 site collection to enable information flow and collaboration
• Led 4 working groups to conduct gap analysis and identify shortfalls within the organization
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Analytical Skills · Problem Solving · Interpersonal Skills

positions.title: Executive Officer, SIS ,HHBn, 1st CAV DIV
positions.description:
• Second in charge of a telecommunication installation and maintenance company consisting of 90 employees and $23 million worth of equipment. 
• Resourced, directed, and coordinated all of the administrative, maintenance, logistics, and training support functions.
• Coordinated with upper management and multiple organizations to plan, resource and execute projects to meet strategic and operational goals.
• Constantly sought after by peers and superiors to provide technical experience to develop unique solutions to complex problems.
• Coordinated and managed the upgrade and installation of 10 critical pieces of communication equipment valued at over $5 million resulting in a 95% operational readiness rate.

positions.title: Operations Manager
positions.description:
• Coordinated, planned, and scheduled the training, maintenance and operational projects of 52 employees across 8 departments, and over $21 million worth of telecommunication installation and maintenance equipment. 
• Managed the installation, operation and maintenance of a communications infrastructure directly supporting over 800 customers over a 90-day operation with 99% network uptime. 
• Developed and implemented the Company maintenance program to conduct preventive maintenance, identify, and repair faults for 60 vehicles/power units and 12 communication assemblages. 
• Coordinated, resourced and executed the fielding and integration of new telecommunications equipment into the organizations network infrastructure.
• Developed training for all employees in preparation for a large-scale network infrastructure support mission; resulted in all departments receiving cross-training in all functions of the organization.
• Developed project reports and progress tracking metrics to provide a status to clients and upper management; met with clients to ensure consistent, on-time results delivery in accordance with the required resource allocations.
• Completed introductory leadership training, leadership training school and communications officer leadership school.
